traditionalDress.men: Panache / traditional dhoti or panche, often paired with a kurta or jubba; the Mysuru peta is a distinctive ceremonial turban.
traditionalDress.women: Saree traditions include Mysore silk and regional handloom styles.

festivals.name: Mysuru Dasara
festivals.description: A ten-day cultural celebration in Mysuru with palace illumination, music, dance, processions and the Jamboo Savari on Vijayadashami.

festivals.name: Ugadi
festivals.description: The Kannada New Year, marked by rituals, festive foods and the seasonal idea of a new beginning.

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti
festivals.description: A harvest festival celebrated across Karnataka with family gatherings and regional food traditions.

danceForms: Bharatanatyam (practised in Karnataka as well as other southern regions)
folklore: Karnataka's oral traditions range from epic and devotional storytelling to village performance traditions such as Yakshagana, where music, dance, dialogue and elaborate costume come together.
